label: CHECK 10's fires-when coverage divides matches by the rule bullet's own word count, so a ten-word bullet passes at 0.30 while a one-word bullet must match 100 percent; the v4.0.0.3 short-stem change adds a synthetic <stem>e token for three-letter stems, enlarging the denominator of exactly the bullets it was written to rescue. Removing the synthetic token breaks only the two tests added in the same commit; all 62 real bullets still pass.

After 568d2b12c9 re-pointed the rule canary at AGENTS.md, the delivery-prefix check reports its last anchor (Blast-Radius Management) ending at byte 16379 against a 16384 cap: five bytes of headroom, one word. The next edit that nudges that section fails as a rule-invariant violation rather than a budget overflow.

sk-doc's classifier-cite-drift-scan.mjs imports cli-classifier's jev-features and jev-transport at module load, and validate_document.py drives the advisory through that path. Removing or renaming cli-classifier makes the advisory vanish rather than degrade, because the load-time import has no guard while the runtime featureSwitch below it does.

ci-skill-root-metadata.cjs skips folders named local- and reports a bare checked=14 passed=14 failed=0 while .skilled/skills holds 16 skills, so a broken local-obsidian or local-webflow block is indistinguishable from a fleet with no local-* skills. Every other gate states its population (files=13, bullets=62); this one states only what it looked at.

Four gates in one iteration produced four success vocabularies: check-repo-rules.cjs prints 11/11 PASS plus RESULT: PASSED, check-rule-copies.js prints OK:, ci-skill-root-metadata.cjs prints checked=14 passed=14 failed=0, and validate.sh demands the literal RESULT: PASSED. Three mechanisms would close it, each rooted in two registry findings: a validator contract with exit 0 pass / 1 findings / 2 could-not-check and a RESULT token (finding-8-13, F4); one routing test harness driving compiled-route.cjs from a prompt table (the recorded route replays and the unsettled sk-design none outcome); and one shared template lint serving both the playbook marker check (finding-4-34) and F1's inverted denominator.
